description: Playas y Faros is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ideas.asturias.es. Digital cartography of the beaches and lighthouses of Asturias. Made in 2017. It consists of the following information: FAROS: geographical location; international and national number; code in the project; name according to the relationship of the Port Authority to which it belongs; council in which it is located; Port Authority to which it belongs; elevation ... Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Beaches and Lighthouses" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include SITPA, Cubierta terrestre, Cartografia, Regiones biogeográficas, mapa, Faros. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
